prompt.alinti: Comment “HTML” and I’ll send you the repo and the full setup guide.
Anthropix Cloud Code Team stopped writing their docs in Markdown, and it changes something you send out every single week.
Markdown is the plain text Cloud hands you. Fine on your own screen, but a client opens it and reads it like a raw text file.
HTML is that exact same content built as a real page, with a layout and proper headings, so it actually looks designed.
So every proposal, report, and client recap you've pulled out of Cloud lands as notes, while it could have been landing as something that looks like a magazine.
Nobody's fixing it because building that page by hand means CSS grids and fonts.
So somebody built HTML Anything. It's free open source and hands the whole job to Claude.
You paste in your spreadsheet a note or something Claude already wrote for you. You hit enter and it builds the finished page while you watch it render.
There's 75 templates across nine formats. So the same box gives you a client report, a pitch deck, or even a landing page.
It just uses the cloud login you're already paying for.
Then one click turns it into an image for a post or a file you send straight to the client.
Just comment HTML and I'll send you the full guide plus the repo so you can try it yourself.
And the team behind this built Open Design, which has 40,000 stars and over 200 contributions.
